enumerator BAS_WRITE_NOTIFY_ENABLE

Response write type for bas_set_notify to enable CCCD.

enumerator BAS_WRITE_NOTIFY_DISABLE

Response write type for bas_set_notify to disable CCCD.

enum T_BAS_READ_TYPE

BAS client read type.

Values:

enumerator BAS_READ_NOTIFY

Response read type for bas_read_notify to read CCCD value.

enum T_BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE

BAS client callback type.

Values:

enumerator BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_DISC_STATE

Discovery procedure state, done or pending.

enumerator BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_READ_RESULT

Read request's result data, responded from server.

enumerator BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_WRITE_RESULT

Write result, success or fail.

enumerator BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_NOTIF_IND_RESULT

Notification or indication data received from server.

enumerator BAS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_INVALID

Invalid callback type, no practical usage.
